brief: The canvas presents a mesmerizing, continuous field of interlocking hexagonal tessellations. These vibrant geometric shapes are in constant, slow-moving rotation, forming complex, flowing patterns reminiscent of a digitized liquid structure. The visual style utilizes a saturated, nostalgic 1980s color palette. The defining feature is the visible, cyclical shifting of color saturation; viewers will observe sections of the tessellation suddenly deepening in chroma or softening to muted tones. The patterns evolve autonomously, creating a ceaseless, hypnotic interplay of color and motion.

statement: This sketch creates a mesmerizing field of rotating hexagonal tessellations that evoke the fluid motion of digitized liquid. The visual style employs a saturated 1980s color palette with vibrant hues and dynamic saturation shifts. Each hexagon in the grid rotates independently while its color cycles through varying levels of chroma, creating a hypnotic interplay of motion and color. The continuous rotation and shifting saturation produce an autonomous, ever-evolving pattern that appears to flow like a living liquid structure. The use of WEBGL rendering ensures smooth 3D transformations and depth perception, while the algorithmic color modulation creates natural-looking transitions between vibrant and muted tones across the entire canvas.
